channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Trump threatens broader strikes in Iran amid escalating conflict
item.description: US President Donald Trump warned that the United States may expand strikes in Iran as the war with Israel entered its second week. The warning came after Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian apologised to Gulf countries hit by missile attacks but rejected calls for unconditional surrende

item.title: Naga Chaitanya, Sobhita Dhulipala seek blessings at Jagannath temple; fans say 'they have no compatibility, cold couple'
item.description: Actors Naga Chaitanya and Sobhita Dhulipala visited Jagannath Temple in Puri, Orissa, where they offered prayers and sought blessings just months after their first wedding anniversary. The couple arrived at the temple amid tight security.

item.title: OpenAI robotics chief resigns over Pentagon AI deal
item.description: OpenAI stated that the Defense Department deal establishes a "workable path" for responsible national security AI use while maintaining red lines, including no domestic surveillance and no lethal autonomy.

item.title: Israeli drone strikes Ramada Hotel in Beirut as Iranian attacks hit Kuwait
item.description: Authorities in Dubai responded to multiple incidents over the weekend after debris from intercepted missiles fell in the area. A facility near Bahrain's Port Salman was targeted by Iran.

item.title: Netanyahu says attack on Iran to continue with 'full force'
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel will keep up its military campaign against Iran with "full force," calling it defensive and urging Lebanon to disarm Hezbollah or face consequences.

item.title: 'India can win T20 World Cup final if Modi stays away from stadium,' says Priyank Kharge
item.description: Kharge criticized the government for prioritizing celebrity engagements over serious issues like the IRIS Dena sinking, while other leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Mamata Banerjee, have called Modi "Panauti," blaming him for India's cricket losses.

item.title: Self-defence to continue till US-Israel 'aggression' ends or UN names aggressors: Iran
item.description: The ministry condemned the attacks as violations of Iran's sovereignty and international law, citing Article 51 of the UN Charter and UN General Assembly Resolution 3314 on military aggression. Iran stressed that states allowing their territory to be used for aggression bear international legal responsibility.

item.title: How Tehran's low‑cost swarm tactics have Trump and US cornered in multifront war
item.description: Iran's IRGC launched "Operation Great Prophet 19," striking the USS Dwight D. Eisenhower with 800+ drones and missiles, halting Strait of Hormuz oil traffic for four days amid Khamenei's funeral rallies.

item.title: West Asia conflict: UAE advises citizens against filming incident sites, prohibited areas
item.description: The Embassy of India in Abu Dhabi advised Indian nationals to follow local safety guidelines, avoid taking or sharing photos/videos of damaged areas, and report suspicious objects to authorities.

item.title: International Women's Day Special: The woman behind 1,356 free schools & mission to educate India
item.description: This International Women's Day, the story of Smt. Bhanumathi Narasimhan highlights a quiet yet powerful movement transforming education across India. Through The Art of Living's network of 1,356 free schools in 22 states, more than 120,000 children, many of them first-generation learners, are receiving holistic, value-based education.
